_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Owncast
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Owncast is a self-hosted live video and web chat server that streams from OBS or any RTMP software. The egg installs it with ffmpeg, so it is ready to stream to.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Owncast: downloads Owncast from its GitHub releases and a static ffmpeg
# (which Owncast needs to transcode the stream) from BtbN's FFmpeg builds,
# each checked against its published checksum. The database, uploads and
# backups in data/ are never touched; binaries are only replaced once the
# new ones have downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=owncast/owncast
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# GitHub releases, through the installer's gh-release (GitHub's API has a
# low anonymous limit). gh_tag <latest|tag> prints the release's tag;
# returns 1 when there's no such release, 2 when GitHub can't be reached.
gh_tag() {
    local out
    out=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$1" 2>&1) && { echo "$out"; return 0; }
    case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
}
offline="GitHub can't be reached right now, or is limiting downloads. Reinstall to try again in a few minutes."
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=64bit ffarch=linux64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ffarch=linuxarm64 ;;
    *) fail "Owncast has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
case "$version" in latest|v*) ;; *) version="v$version" ;; esac
rc=0; tag=$(gh_tag "$version") || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    latest=$(gh_tag latest) || fail "$offline"
    fail "Owncast has no version ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest."
fi
[ "$rc" = 0 ] || fail "$offline"
version=$tag
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$version") || fail "$offline"
read -r asset sum < <(awk -v a="linux-$arch.zip" 'substr($1, length($1) - length(a) + 1) == a { print; exit }' <<<"$assets") || true
[ -n "${asset:-}" ] || fail "Owncast $version has no Linux build for this CPU. Choose another version."

tmp=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$tmp" && mkdir -p "$tmp"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
if [ "$sum" != - ] && [ -x owncast ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-owncast 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Owncast $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Owncast $version"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$version" "$asset" "$tmp/owncast.zip" || fail "The download failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q -o "$tmp/owncast.zip" owncast -d "$tmp"
    chmod +x "$tmp/owncast"
    mv -f "$tmp/owncast" owncast
    echo "$sum" > .raptor-owncast
fi

# ffmpeg: the newest release build (not the development one) for this CPU.
ff=https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest
sums=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$ff/checksums.sha256") || fail "The ffmpeg builds can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
line=$(grep -E "  ffmpeg-n[0-9.]+-latest-$ffarch-gpl-[0-9.]+\.tar\.xz$" <<<"$sums" | sort -V -k2 | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$line" ] || fail "There's no ffmpeg build for this CPU right now. Reinstall to try again later."
ffsum=${line%% *}
ffname=${line##* }
if [ -x ffmpeg ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-ffmpeg 2>/dev/null)" = "$ffsum" ]; then
    echo "ffmpeg is up to date."
else
    echo "Downloading ${ffname%.tar.xz}"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" "$ff/$ffname"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$ffsum" ] || fail "The ffmpeg download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xJf "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" -C "$tmp" --wildcards --strip-components=2 '*/bin/ffmpeg'
    mv -f "$tmp/ffmpeg" ffmpeg
    echo "$ffsum" > .raptor-ffmpeg
fi
# A new Owncast's admin password is abc123, which anyone could guess. Unless
# Admin password is set, start it once here to give it a random one.
if [ ! -f data/owncast.db ] && [ -z "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    password=$(head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '/+=')
    ./owncast -webserverip 127.0.0.1 -webserverport 18089 -rtmpport 18090 -adminpassword "$password" > "$tmp/first.log" 2>&1 &
    pid=$!
    for _ in $(seq 60); do
        grep -q "Web server is listening" "$tmp/first.log" && break
        kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 1
    done
    kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" || true
    grep -q "Admin password changed" "$tmp/first.log" || { cat "$tmp/first.log"; fail "Owncast didn't start to set its admin password. Reinstall to try again."; }
    echo "The admin page's password (user admin) is $password. Change it there, or set Admin password."
fi
echo "Installed Owncast $version with ${ffname%-latest-*}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Owncast version to install, such as 0.3.0, or latest.

variables.name: RTMP port
variables.description: The port OBS or other streaming software sends the stream to. Add it to the server's ports first.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Sets the password of the admin page (user admin) at every start. Empty keeps the one set in the admin page.

variables.name: Stream key
variables.description: A stream key used at every start, on top of the keys set in the admin page. Empty uses only those.
